parsed.note: The post only proposes increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 (and later WARMUP_RATIO), which are normal capacity/optimization hyperparameters; TRAIN_SHARDS stays '0-9' so shard 10 (the eval data) is not trained on, and the fixed evaluation block is untouched, so val_bpb still measures real model quality.
